report:
Finding: No finetuning effect detectable. Model B is effectively identical to Model A.

Reasoning:
- Difference norms are 0.000 at every layer and token position. This indicates the residual-stream activations of B and A are the same (to numerical precision) across the measured positions.
- Logit-lens readouts are identical, generic, and uniform across all (layer, position) cells (“ o”, “is”, “it”, etc.). That’s what you expect when the difference vector is ~zero: any tiny numerical noise yields a default, frequency-like ranking rather than a coherent, task-specific direction.
- Patchscope readouts show no distinctive continuations (none provided), consistent with no injected signal.
- With zero residual differences everywhere (including the “60 highest-norm” cells), there’s no concentrated signal pointing to a domain, behavior, or objective.

Conclusion: The finetuning objective was “none” (control) or failed/applied no effective changes—Model B behaves the same as Model A on this probe. Any remaining differences, if they exist, are below detection or irrelevant to the early-token residual stream.
